entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT
entities.description: A 5G NAS message used to convey network slice-specific authentication results between the network and UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol being used in the NAS message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the type of security header applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Reserved bits for alignment in the NAS message header.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message identity
entities.description: Identifies the specific message type within the NAS protocol.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information identifying a network slice.

entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Extensible Authentication Protocol message used for authentication procedures.

relations.description: The NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION RESULT message contains the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
